newsitem.title: USA: American General, USLIFE in $1.8 bln merger.
newsitem.headline: American General, USLIFE in $1.8 bln merger.

text.p: American General Corp said Thursday it has a definitive agreement to merge with USLIFE Corp in a stock deal valued at $1.8 billion.
Under the pact, USLIFE shareholders will receive $49 worth of American General stock for each USLIFE share, American General said.
"This merger represents the largest transaction in American General's history and is an outstanding strategic fit," American General Chief Executive Robert Devlin said in a release.
American General said the deal will be tax-free to USLIFE shareholders and is expected to be non-dilutive.
American General shares closed up 7/8 at 41-1/2 Wednesday. USLIFE shares closed at 41-3/4.
The combined entity would have assets of $74 billion and 1996 earnings of $757 million in $9 billion in revenues, American General said.
The companies are scheduled to discuss their merger in a conference call later this morning scheduled at 1000.
